card.fires_on: Mostly the space, small linking word or number right after a fatty acid or omega-3 phrase, often before an amount or lab term. The pole is a negative one and fires in nutrition and supplement text.

modes.description: The blank space or number right before a gram or mg amount of omega-3 or fatty acid.
